keySentence: Privilege should never be used to define identity.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Sara and Lavinia both began at Miss Minchin's school with wealth and social advantage. But they had built their identities on completely different and very revealing foundations. Lavinia used her money to decide how important she was compared to everyone else around her. Sara had never allowed her wealth to become the core of what she thought she was inside. When Sara lost everything, her identity remained completely stable and unchanged and clear. When Lavinia's position was briefly challenged, she felt shaken to her very foundation. A person's worth must be built on something deeper than what they happen to own right now. Privilege should never be used to define identity.
facts.Word cards: privilege = 특권 / permanent = 영원한 / define = 정의하다 / identity = 정체성
